consequence.statement: Operators who leave the new value unset are unaffected: the default (false) keeps HTTP-01 ACME challenges enabled and cert-manager's pod-creation permission in place, so nothing changes on upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Optionally set global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole=true if HTTP-01 ACME challenges are not required, to drop cert-manager's permission to create pods.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds the Helm value global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole (default false), which when set disables HTTP-01 ACME challenges so cert-manager can drop its permission to create pods.
